'''Unbreaking''' is an [[enchantment]] that makes items lose durability more slowly. It works as in vanilla, but in [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is one of the hardest enchantments to get, because the blessings that give it need a [[Divine Fragment]] or a [[Divine Favor]].<ref>{{Cite video|quote=If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment.}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Source !! Level !! Cost
|-
| [[Prayer of Prometheus]] || II || [[Divine Fragment]], 3 diamonds, 4 [[Estus Ash]]
|-
| [[Prayer of Daedalus]] || III (with Efficiency III) || [[Divine Favor]], diamond pickaxe, diamond axe, diamond, 4 Estus Ash
|-
| Prayer of The God-King [[Ofuda]] || I (with Efficiency II) || [[The Avesta]] and a [[Crystal Heart]], traded to an apprentice [[Mouthpiece]]
|}
Unbreaking also appears on random enchanted books in chests and fishing treasure.

== Behavior ==
Unbreaking works as in vanilla. Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 2.
